title: Figure 5: Delta-lifting body design models, AFFDL configurations 1958-68
description: Black-and-white photograph of about a dozen small wind-tunnel-style models of delta-planform lifting bodies and gliders arranged on a light background, with numbered markers 1 through 10 identifying configurations. Caption: "Figure 5. Delta-Lifting Body Designs. Array of delta-lifting body designs shows configuration is not limited to high hypersonic lift-to-drag ratios, high cross range, and large size." Text describes AFFDL, McDonnell Douglas and Lockheed hypersonic glider work.
